name: ProPresenter
shortDescription: Subscription worship-presentation software for live services, with multi-screen production tools, stage displays and media workflows.
suitableContexts: Churches with live-production needs beyond basic projection
Teams managing multiple screens or stage displays

pricing.summary: Renewed Vision publishes subscription pricing in US dollars for individual seats and worship-campus licences, with monthly and annual billing options.
pricing.trialDetails: 14 days, full ProPresenter trial according to the supplier.

support: 7-day support access stated by the supplier

editorial.assessment: ProPresenter is a production-tool decision rather than a church database choice. Its subscription and licence scope need to be set against the actual number of operators, screens, venues and volunteers—not just the main Sunday projector.
bestFor: Teams needing stage-display and advanced presentation control
strengths: Campus licence covers a stated 20 seats for worship customers
limitations: Content, Bible and media licences remain separate church responsibilities

longForm.verdict: ProPresenter becomes worthwhile when a church’s live-production workflow needs reliable control across multiple screens and operators. A trial should test the actual Sunday setup, including the volunteer handover—not only slide design on one laptop.

decisionLens.heading: Licence scope follows the production workflow, not the size of the congregation.
decisionLens.text: Count production computers, operators, stage displays and venues. Then test the exact output, audio, media and remote-control behaviour the team needs under live-service conditions.

sections.heading: Testing the live environment
sections.question: Will it reduce pressure on the people running services?
paragraphs: Renewed Vision publishes Standard per-seat and Campus licences, alongside a 14-day free trial. The product information describes live presentation and multi-screen production workflows.

Use the trial in rehearsal with real media, presentation files and outputs. Confirm any required Bible, song, font and media licences separately; the software subscription does not provide all content rights.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on Renewed Vision’s current pricing and product information.
themes: Live-output reliability and volunteer workflow should be tested in rehearsal.
Licence choice depends on seats and campus use, not a generic church-size label.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier feature material is not independent testing or a guarantee of fit with a particular AV setup.

faq.question: Does ProPresenter have a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Renewed Vision advertises a 14-day free trial. Test it with the church’s real displays, media and volunteers before subscribing.

faq.question: How much does ProPresenter cost?
faq.answer: The supplier publishes Standard at $29/month or $289/year per seat, and a worship-only Campus licence at $59/month or $649/year for 20 seats.

faq.question: Does ProPresenter include song and Bible licences?
faq.answer: Do not assume so. Churches remain responsible for their relevant song, Bible, font and media licences; confirm the content rights required for each service.

seo.title: ProPresenter review for UK churches
seo.description: Independent ProPresenter profile for UK churches: subscription prices, 14-day trial, live-production fit, licence questions and FAQs.
